id: BD-V-006

  - id: apply-idea

  - id: review-next-connection
    what: review stage
    instructional_role: links to next module

  - show-explanation-or-application -> apply-idea: learning rhythm
  - apply-idea -> explain-own-words: learning rhythm
  - explain-own-words -> review-next-connection: learning rhythm
reading_order: [learn-key-idea, show-explanation-or-application, apply-idea, explain-own-words, review-next-connection]

Pages/cards are blank; there are no labels, grades, certificates, QR codes, arrows, frames, or decorative marks. Book/card treatments support learning and offline practice without adding a new competency or assessment claim. Figures, props, and positions can be rebuilt as editable shapes. All stage strings and qualifications remain in the source text layer.
